entries.definition: A system that observes the state of an environment and repeatedly chooses actions from a fixed, typed set to change that state, rather than producing a single one-shot output.
One agent configuration (prompt, action set) used unmodified across different task categories, as opposed to a bespoke configuration per benchmark.
The small, fixed set of action types an agent can emit (here: running code, running a shell command, interacting with a browser).
The fraction of benchmark instances (e.g., GitHub issues) for which the agent's submitted patch is judged to fix the issue.
A 300-instance subset of the SWE-Bench benchmark of real GitHub issues, used for cost reasons instead of the full 2294-instance set.
The agent is given no worked examples of the task before attempting it.
Graduate-level Google-proof Q&A, a benchmark of graduate-level multiple-choice science questions; the 'diamond' subset is its hardest tier.
